audit.whatIsWrong: Chart disagreed with the packet levelChart and with its own whys at rows 1, 4-5, 1st item and 2+ items — most damagingly it called 2+ items for Mordekaiser while whys[6], spikes[3] and the late text all say Akali out-scales.
audit.why: The page rendered Mordekaiser winning the late game and Akali winning the late game at the same time.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill, Mordekaiser x5, Akali in matched full+content pairs; ratings and phases[3]/[5]/[6] why-text rewritten to agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere; dosFull[2] was titled Build MR but described baiting the Shroud.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud is the tracked cooldown and the page never said how long it lasts to come back.
audit.corrected: Twilight Shroud written as 20s at rank 1, Five Point Strike as a 110-energy cost, and dosFull[2].d now names Mercury’s Treads and an MR item.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Realm of Death is a targeted 650-range cast and Akali is unselectable by enemy spells inside Twilight Shroud, so R fizzles into the smoke. Perfect Execution’s recast execute was also absent.
audit.why: Riot’s W text says outright she is unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks; the R text says the recast executes.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[0].d, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t now state the fizzle; dontsFull[1].d tells you to track the execute threshold.

edits.before: Q ranks make isolated hits massive. Akali must hug minions all lane; punish every step away from the wave with the full drag combo.
edits.after: Q ranks make isolated hits massive and her Q costs 110 energy. Bait the 20s Shroud, then E-pull her in and grind her in the aura.

edits.before: Liandry's makes Darkness Rise melt through bruiser HP stacking. Extended trades are now strictly yours — force them.
edits.after: Liandry's plus the max-HP aura out-DPSes a pre-Hextech Akali. E-pull her into a point-blank fight and she cannot leave.

edits.before: Riftmaker omnivamp turns the Realm 1v1 unloseable into most matchups. Akali's only outs are dodging Q forever or never being alone — neither survives a whole game.
edits.after: Two AP items and she one-rotations you out of Shroud, then recasts Perfect Execution to dash clear of your 675-range Q. Never face-check her alone.

edits.before: - Akali Twilight Shroud: matchup-defining — Untargetable inside it. R her when down. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Akali Twilight Shroud: matchup-defining — 20s, and she is unselectable inside it, so your R fizzles. Fight it down.

edits.before: Akali wastes Twilight Shroud — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Mercury's Treads and an MR item blunt her one-rotation burst.

edits.before: That is Akali's favourite window — refuse it and half her win condition is gone.
edits.after: R is targeted; she is unselectable in Shroud for 20s, so it fizzles outright.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Perfect Execution's recast executes below a threshold — track the number.

edits.before: Track Akali's Twilight Shroud: Untargetable inside it. R her when down. When it is down — R her — the realm is yours.
edits.after: Twilight Shroud: 20s, and she is unselectable inside it, so a targeted R fizzles. Cast it once the smoke is gone.

notes: Mordekaiser Q Obliterate carries a derived grounding flag that Riot’s description does not support (damage only, increased on a single target), so nothing here claims Q denies Shuriken Flip or Perfect Execution — same call the akali-side audit made. suspectNames flagged "Drop Twilight Shroud" as a wrong name; it is a false positive, Twilight Shroud is correct. The Assassin’s Mark auto-reset missing-interaction was not written: Riot’s passive text describes an empowered next attack with bonus range, not a reset, and no slot on the page had room without cutting a verified fact.
